findings.title: wp2shell: Pre Authentication RCE in WordPress Core
findings.summary_md: Searchlight Cyber's security research team, credited to Adam Kues, disclosed a pre-authentication RCE in WordPress Core exploitable by an anonymous user on a stock install with no plugins, affecting 6.9.0-6.9.4 and 7.0.0-7.0.1 while versions 6.8.5 and earlier are not affected. The firm withheld technical details at disclosure to give defenders time to patch and launched wp2shell.com, a public checker for vulnerable instances. It recommended updating to 7.0.2 or 6.9.5, or as temporary measures blocking /wp-json/batch/v1 and ?rest_route=/batch/v1 at a WAF or installing a plugin that blocks anonymous REST API access.

findings.title: WordPress 7.0.2 Release
findings.summary_md: The vendor advisory shipped 7.0.2 addressing one critical and one high severity security issue and enabled forced updates via the auto-update system for sites running affected versions. It credits Adam Kues at Assetnote / Searchlight Cyber for the REST API batch-route confusion and SQL injection leading to Remote Code Execution, and the team of TF1T, dtro, and haongo for a facilitated SQL injection. Backports shipped as 6.9.5 for both issues and 6.8.6 for the SQL injection alone, versions prior to 6.8 are not affected, and 7.1 beta2 also received fixes. It lists GHSA-ff9f-jf42-662q (CVE-2026-63030) and GHSA-fpp7-x2x2-2mjf (CVE-2026-60137).

findings.title: GHSA-ff9f-jf42-662q: REST API batch-route confusion and SQL injection issue leading to Remote Code Execution
findings.summary_md: The WordPress maintainers published GHSA-ff9f-jf42-662q for CVE-2026-63030, rated Critical: a REST API batch-route confusion weakness that, combined with the GHSA-fpp7-x2x2-2mjf SQL injection, leads to Remote Code Execution. Affected versions are 6.9.0-6.9.4 and 7.0.0-7.0.1, patched in 6.9.5, 7.0.2, and 7.1 beta2. The advisory notes the vulnerability was discovered and responsibly disclosed by Adam Kues at Assetnote / Searchlight Cyber.

findings.title: GHSA-fpp7-x2x2-2mjf: Facilitated SQL injection vulnerability in the author__not_in parameter of WP_Query
findings.summary_md: The WordPress maintainers published GHSA-fpp7-x2x2-2mjf for CVE-2026-60137, rated Moderate: a facilitated SQL injection in the author__not_in parameter of WP_Query. Affected versions span 6.8.0-6.8.5, 6.9.0-6.9.4, and 7.0.0-7.0.1, patched in 6.8.6, 6.9.5, and 7.0.2. On WordPress 6.9 and higher it chains with GHSA-ff9f-jf42-662q to achieve Remote Code Execution. It was discovered and responsibly disclosed as a team by TF1T, dtro, and haongo.
